spec: Agent Messaging §7.3.1, Updates a Transport Does Not Carry; A2A over Agent Messaging (bindings/a2a.md) §5, §8
comment: A view of a Task that a transport does not show every update of (a requester over email, a caller over A2A) must decide whether to take an update it receives. Under wire version 0.4.0 the states are A2A's own and A2A gives no transition table: a Task moves only through A2A's states, and a Task in a terminal state does not move again (binding §5). So a view takes any update in an A2A state unless the last state it saw is terminal, and it fills no gap, because A2A names no path to fill it with. A carrier without subjects numbers whole Tasks by seq (binding §8), so order comes from seq, not from the states. Those are the wire_0_4_0 cases. The cases under 'cases' are the reading of Agent Messaging 0.9's own transition table (§7.3) for 0.3.0 envelopes, kept for the binding's transition window: 'applies' says whether the view takes the update, 'passed_through' lists, in order, the states it takes as passed through but not seen, and a refused update is TASK_INVALID_TRANSITION. lib/check-unseen-states.mjs runs every case against a reference reading of each rule.
